Depth sed.description: Sediment depth measurements in meters for forty-five samples from Leg 112, Site 680.

Epoch.description: Geological epoch classification for sediment samples, specifically Pleistocene or Pliocene.

Sample label.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for forty-five sediment samples from Leg 112, Site 680.

Leg.description: Leg 112 identifier for the sediment sampling expedition.

H.description: H is a categorical string variable with a single unique value of A.

Core.description: Integer identifier for sediment core segments within the sampled leg.

Type.description: Sediment sample classification code, consistently recorded as H.

Sect.description: Sediment section identifiers ranging from 1 to 7.

Sect_2.description: Sediment section identifiers ranging from 5 to 130.

Sect_3.description: Sect3 is an integer column containing numerical values ranging from 6 to 131.

Al.description: Aluminum concentrations in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

Ca.description: Calcium concentrations in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

Fe.description: Iron concentration in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

K.description: Potassium concentrations in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

Mn.description: Manganese concentrations in sediment samples, ranging from 0.15 to 0.52.

Na.description: Sodium concentrations in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

P.description: Continuous geochemical measurements ranging from 0.77 to 10.73 in sediment samples.

Mo.description: Molybdenum concentrations in sediment samples, measured in parts per million.

U.description: Uranium concentrations in parts per million for forty-five sediment samples.

N.description: Continuous probability scores ranging from 0.05 to 0.98.

S.description: Sulfur concentration in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

TOC.description: Total organic carbon concentration in sediment samples, measured in percent.

TC.description: Total carbon content in sediment samples, measured in percent.

Fe/Al.description: Iron-to-aluminum ratio in sediment samples, ranging from 0.26 to 1.15.

Mn/Al.description: Manganese to aluminum ratio in sediment samples, ranging from 3.84 to 7.12.

Mo xs.description: Molybdenum concentration in sediment samples, measured in parts per million.

U xs.description: Uranium concentration in sediment samples, measured in parts per million.

EF.description: EF values range from 1.85 to 117.78, representing continuous geochemical measurements.

EF_2.description: EF2 records continuous geochemical measurements ranging from 1.2 to 25.12.

Feac.description: Continuous probability scores ranging from 0.11 to 0.85.

FeD.description: Dithionite-extractable iron concentrations in sediment samples.

Femag.description: Femag values range from 0.02 to 0.16, with a mean of approximately 0.07.

Fe Py.description: Continuous probability scores for iron pyrite presence in sediment samples.

Fe react.description: Reactive iron concentrations in sediment samples, measured in weight percent.

Ratio.description: Continuous probability scores ranging from 0.31 to 0.82.

Ratio_2.description: Continuous probability scores ranging from 0.03 to 0.5.

δ15N.description: Nitrogen-15 isotopic composition of sediment samples, expressed in per mil relative to atmospheric nitrogen.

δ13C Corg.description: Carbon-13 isotopic composition of organic carbon in sediment samples.

δ98Mo auth.description: Authigenic molybdenum isotope ratios (δ98Mo) in sediment samples, ranging from 1.01 to 2.08.

Event.description: The Event column identifies the specific geological site code 112-680A for all sediment samples.

Latitude.description: Latitude values in decimal degrees for the sediment sampling location.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate for sediment sample locations, measured in decimal degrees.

Elevation.description: Elevation values in meters below sea level for sediment samples.

Date/Time.description: The timestamp records the date and time of the sediment sample collection.

973695.description: Forty-five sediment samples with geochemical data from Leg 112, Site 680, dated November 5, 1986.

description: 973,695 tables of Earth science data recorded on November 5, 1986.
